thread:
maria: CI red on main — golden diff for `rendering/chat/concise_answer.snap`. Noticed in the nightly run. https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4921 :thinking_face:
ci-bot: Build 4921 failed 2 tests in pkg/generator — golden mismatch in rendering/chat/concise_answer.snap (expected 12 lines, got 11). Artifacts: /artifacts/4921/goldens.zip
kevin: ugh. was there a serializer PR merged yesterday? seeing similar small whitespace drops in other suites earlier. @lena do you recall?
sam: I can try a local repro real quick. Which commit is HEAD for that build?
maria: HEAD is 1f4b2c3 (merge main -> release). Link to commit: https://git.example/1f4b2c3
kevin: quick triage plan: 1) rerun CI job (flake?) 2) if still fails, run a git-bisect with a test filter 3) confirm if it's serialization/whitespace or prompt-generation change
lena: yes, a small serialization tweak landed in PR #814 last night — it trims trailing spaces in some prompters. Could be related.
sam: ok reproducing locally: `pytest tests/goldens/test_concise_answer.py -k concise_answer -q` fails with same diff. Minimal repro: run with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0` and `python -m pytest tests/goldens/test_concise_answer.py::test_snapshot`
kevin: run bisect like this:
```
git bisect start HEAD 88a7f10  # known-good
git bisect run scripts/run_single_test.sh tests/goldens/test_concise_answer.py::test_snapshot
```
should narrow to a commit quickly.
maria: can someone kick a rerun first? If it's flaky we might avoid bisect. @devops-bot can you rerun build 4921? :pray:
devops-bot: Rerun requested by maria. Build 4921 queued as rerun-4921. You will be notified on completion.
ci-bot: rerun complete — still failing, same diff.
kevin: ok bisect time. I started git bisect locally and it pointed to PR #814 (lena) as the first bad. lena, can you take a look at the serializer change to confirm whether it intentionally trims trailing spaces in model output?
lena: yeah PR #814 did add `.rstrip()` in prompter render to address noise. I thought it was safe but maybe some golden snapshots relied on trailing spaces. I can open a revert/patch PR, but first want to know if we should update goldens instead.
sam: if it's just trailing whitespace differences we can either update snapshots or change the serializer to keep whitespace for older models. Which is less risky?
kevin: prefer behavioral preservation — if the model used to emit trailing spaces, changing serializer is a breaking change for tests. For now create a targeted patch: make `.rstrip()` opt-in behind a flag or only apply for new model family. Then run full test suite.
maria: filing a tracking issue and adding to the patch checklist. I'll open a quick PR to revert the `.rstrip()` and add a changelog entry. Anyone want to review fast?
lena: I'll review. Also adding a migration note for any team that relied on trimmed output.
kevin: after patch lands, we should run the golden update script to see intended changes: `scripts/update_golds.sh --path rendering/chat/concise_answer.snap --commit <patch-commit>`
sam: fyi if you want to rerun the failing tests in CI without a full rebuild use the job replay API: `curl -X POST https://ci.redwood.example/api/v1/jobs/4921/replay -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"`
maria: thanks — will do. I'll post the PR link here when ready.
ci-bot: new PR 843 opened by maria: "revert: prompter .rstrip() to preserve golden behavior" — Build triggered: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/4950
devops-bot: Build 4950 queued for PR 843.
kevin: once 843 passes, let's run a full golden update pipeline and only update snapshots intentionally. Also add a tiny test to assert trailing-space semantics to avoid regressions.
maria: agreed. Thanks everyone. We'll close the loop after CI green. :white_check_mark:
